translation:
For alternating chills and fever, add green tangerine peel (青皮). <ins>Ten Complete Great Supplementation Decoction (十全大補湯)</ins>
This is the Eight Treasures Decoction (八珍湯) with added astragalus (黃耆) and cinnamon bark (肉桂), one qian each. <ins>Fermented Soybean Cake (豆豉餅)</ins>
Jiangxi fermented soybean (江西豆豉)
Above, one ingredient, grind into powder, mix with saliva into a cake the size of a coin and two fen thick, place it on the affected area, and moxa it with moxa cones (艾壯) on top of the cake; when it dries, change it again.
